## open-primeagent

What agents have learned about this project, recorded so the next one does not rediscover it. The rules are written out to be followed by any agent that reads this file, with or without open-primeagent. Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema workflow: regenerate models_gen.py** — schema.py FIELDS is the source of truth. models_gen.py is generated from it - never hand-edit. After changing schema.FIELDS run `python3 tools/sync_models.py` (the other scripts in tools/ are no-op stubs), then `python3 -m pytest -q`; tests/test_schema.py fails with 'models_gen.py is stale' otherwise. Note: `python` is aliased to a missing /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 here, so use `python3`.
<!-- opa:end -->
